IGUI_AmmoLoader_SortTooltip: Перетаскивайте строки, чтобы изменить приоритет перезарядки. При нажатии «Перезарядить» сначала выбирается верхняя строка.
IGUI_AmmoLootDrop_HostWorkshopAdded: Ammo Loot Drop added these Workshop IDs to the Steam Workshop page of these settings: %1 <LINE> <LINE> A hosted game only loads the Workshop mods listed on that page. Without them the server would skip Ammo Loot Drop and any gun pack it needs, nothing would drop, and its settings would go back to the default. <LINE> <LINE> Press SAVE to keep them.
IGUI_AttachBayonetDesc: Установить на оружие штык для ближнего боя.
IGUI_DeployBayonetDesc: Выдвинуть встроенный штык для ближнего боя.
IGUI_DeployBipodDesc: Разложить сошки для повышения устойчивости и удобства прицеливания.
IGUI_FoldBipodDesc: Сложить сошки для более удобного хранения и переноски.
IGUI_FoldStockDesc: Сложить приклад для удобства переноски и хранения.
IGUI_MoveToInventory: Предмет должен находиться в вашем инвентаре.
IGUI_PhunMart.Error.machineGone: Этот автомат больше не существует. Его оставшиеся данные очищены.
IGUI_PhunMart_Admin_PoolUnavailable_disa: Этот пул отключён. Включите его, чтобы увидеть доступные товары.
IGUI_PhunMart_Admin_PoolUnavailable_empt: В этой группе нет товаров: список пуст или отсутствует необходимый мод.
IGUI_PhunMart_Admin_PoolUnavailable_gate: Для этого пула нужен отсутствующий мод, поэтому товары недоступны.
IGUI_PhunMart_Admin_PoolUnavailable_temp: Это шаблон. Товары находятся в унаследованных от него пулах.
IGUI_PhunMart_CoinMaxCents_tooltip: Максимальное количество центов, выпадающих с зомби.
IGUI_PhunMart_CoinMinCents_tooltip: Минимальное количество центов, выпадающих с зомби.
IGUI_PhunMart_CoinSprinterMaxCents_toolt: Максимальное количество центов, выпадающих со спринтера.
IGUI_PhunMart_CoinSprinterMinCents_toolt: Минимальное количество центов, выпадающих со спринтера.
IGUI_PhunMart_Cond_WorldAgeMin: С момента начала мира прошло недостаточно времени (нужно %1 ч)
IGUI_PhunMart_Confirm_Blacklist: Добавить %1 в общий чёрный список? После обновления ассортимента предмет исчезнет из всех магазинов сервера.
IGUI_PhunMart_Confirm_BlacklistN: Добавить %1 предметов в общий чёрный список? После обновления ассортимента они исчезнут из всех магазинов сервера.
IGUI_PhunMart_Confirm_Delete: Delete "%1"? This removes your override and cannot be undone.
IGUI_PhunMart_Confirm_ResetData: Clear the following, for every player, permanently? %1
IGUI_PhunMart_Confirm_ResetWallet: Reset %1's wallet? Their change and unbound balances are cleared. Bound balances stay, since those are the part a reset is meant to preserve.
IGUI_PhunMart_Confirm_RestockAll: Force restock ALL shops? This rebuilds every shop's inventory immediately.
IGUI_PhunMart_Confirm_ShippedDisable: "%1" ships with PhunMart, so it can't be deleted, because the built-in version would just come back. Disable it instead?
IGUI_PhunMart_Confirm_ShippedOnly: "%1" ships with PhunMart and can't be deleted. Edit it instead, or point things at a different price.
IGUI_PhunMart_Cur_Blurb: Everything priced from currency_base follows this. Shops quote the old money until they restock.
IGUI_PhunMart_Cur_Hint_Factor: Prices were written in cents, so they need scaling down. Watch the table and pick a number that reads well
IGUI_PhunMart_Cur_Hint_Item: Anything stackable works. Money is the usual choice because players добыча it
IGUI_PhunMart_Cur_Hint_Kind: Change is deducted from the wallet. An item is taken from the player's bags
IGUI_PhunMart_Cur_Hint_Label: What to call this money on screen. Leave blank to use the предмет name
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_ConditionDefs: Named tests a player must pass before an offer can be bought. Attach them from a pool, group, special or item override; every condition on a row must pass. The perk_ entries are generated for the XP shop.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_GlobalBlacklist: Items barred from every shop. Applies when a machine next restocks. Pool-specific blacklists live on the pool itself, under Pools.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_GroupDefs: Groups organize items by display category, explicit item lists, or special categories. Referenced by pool sources.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_ItemDefs: Settings for one specific item, overriding what its group would otherwise decide: what it costs, what it grants, how often it appears. Anything not listed here just uses its group. Marked [off] is disabled.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_Locations: Every machine standing in the world, nearest first. Double-click a row to teleport to it. Right-clicking a shop on the Shops tab narrows this to that shop.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_PendingRestock: Recent changes may require one or more shops to restock in order for changes to take effect.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_PoolDefs: Pools are the shelves a shop restocks from: each gathers groups, and can set a fallback price and stock for items that name neither. Zones limit a pool to certain map difficulties, months to certain times of year. Marked [S] is always available, [off] is disabled.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_PriceDefs: Именованные шаблоны цен для предметов. Задайте стоимость, валюту и количество.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_RewardDefs: Правила выдачи жетонов за игровые действия, например убийства зомби и проведённое время.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_Shops: Типы магазинов и количество автоматов в мире. ПКМ по строке покажет места их установки.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_SpecialDefs: Особые награды: черты, опыт и усиления. Для каждой задаются действие, отображение, цена и вес.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_Tools: Everything that isn't editing a definition. Pick a tool to see what it does, then run it.
IGUI_PhunMart_Desc_Wallets: What every player is holding. Double-click a balance to change it, or right-click a name to pick which one. A bound balance is the part that survives a wallet reset.
IGUI_PhunMart_Err_Amount: Enter a number of 0 or more
IGUI_PhunMart_Err_NeedItemOrCat: Add at least one item, category or special
IGUI_PhunMart_Err_RangeBoth: Enter both a min and a max, or leave both blank
IGUI_PhunMart_Err_RangeOrder: Max must not be less than min
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Actions: What buying this does. They run in the order listed
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ActionType: What buying this does to the player
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_AmountMixed: These items are asked for in different amounts. Leave blank to keep them, or set one for all of them
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_AmountRange: Change is in dollars; tokens and items are counted whole. Fill the second box to roll a random price between the two
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_BoostMultiplier: XP частота множитель while the boost lasts
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_BoostRange: Active XP boost level, 0 to 3. Leave a box blank for no bound on that end
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ConditionAmount: How many of each предмет the player must be carrying
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ConditionKey: Name for this test. Reusing a name that ships edits that entry rather than making a new one
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ConditionPerk: Which навык the уровень is read from
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Conditions: Tests a player must pass before this can be bought. All of them must pass
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ConditionsLayered: Tests a player must pass, added to whatever the other layers already ask for. All of them must pass
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_CurrencyPool: Название валютного счёта (например, change или tokens)
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_DefaultRoll: (optional) roll: overrides the shop's items per restock, for this set only
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_DefaultTexture: (optional) Default texture for предметы without one
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Destructible: Whether players can destroy this shop's machines with a sledgehammer. Server default follows the sandbox option. Admins can always destroy them
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_DisplayText: Name the player sees in the shop
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Factor: factor: multiplies the inherited amount. Blank = 1
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_GroupGrants: What buying anything in this group gives the player. An item override can change it
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_GroupPrice: What everything in this group costs
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_GroupVehicles: Vehicle scripts sold by this group. The buyer gets the one they picked
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Inherit: Anything not set here comes from this entry
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_InheritKey: inherit: the price this one starts from (optional)
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Key: Required. The id other definitions refer to. Cannot be changed later
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_KeyFixed: The id other definitions refer to. Fixed once created
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Label: Display name for this group's category in the shop UI
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_LevelRange: Skill level, 0 to 10. Leave a box blank for no bound on that end
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MaxPurchases: Fails once the player has bought this offer this many times
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MaxTokens: Passes только while the player holds fewer bound tokens than this
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_MinDistance: (optional) Min tiles from the nearest shop of this type or category
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Months: Only stocked during these in-game months, 1 to 12 (eg 12 for December only). Blank sells all year
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Moveable: Whether players can pick up this shop's machines and place them elsewhere. Server default follows the sandbox option. Admins can always move them
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PlaytimeMinutes: Total minutes played (game time, not real world time). Leave blank to ignore this milestone.
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolBlacklist: Barred from this pool только. Untick to restore.
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolDefaultPrice: (optional) только used by предметы whose group sets no price
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolGrants: What buying anything from this pool gives the player. A group or an item override can change it
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolGroups: The groups this pool draws its предметы from
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolList: Select a pool and press Edit to change how often it is drawn from
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PoolWeightRow: How often this pool is drawn from, relative to the others in this set. 1 is the usual share, 0.5 is half of it
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Powered: Tick if this machine only runs on electricity. It shows the unpowered sprites and cannot be opened while the power is off
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_PriceOverride: What it costs. Leave as it is to follow the template
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Probability: probability: relative chance in the placement lottery. 0 = manual placement only
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Professions: Starting profession keys, comma separated. The player needs any one of them
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_RerollFrequency: (optional) In-game hours before this machine turns into a different shop. Blank follows the sandbox setting, 0 never changes
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Scope: Per character resets on смерть. Per account does not
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SharedKey: (optional) Offers sharing a name share one allowance, for pick one of these, once
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopCategory: Two shops sharing a category are kept apart in the world. Blank spaces this shop against its own type only
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopEnabled: Untick to stop this shop being placed. Machines already standing stay put
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopKey: The shop type. Fixed once created, since placed machines refer to it
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopRoll: How many items this shop draws each restock. Any pool set below can override it for its own shelf
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ShopTitle: Optional. Shown instead of the key, unless this shop has a translated name
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Skill: Perk name as the game spells it, e.g. Cooking or Aiming
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpawnCondition: Percent condition a bought vehicle arrives in, rolled fresh per part. Blank leaves it as the game spawned it
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpawnFuel: Percent of the vehicle's own tank it arrives with, so one range suits a truck and a small car. Blank leaves whatever the game put in
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpecialOverlay: (optional) Second image drawn over the icon, e.g. a tier badge
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_SpecialTexture: (optional) PNG path under media/, or a script item name, to use as the icon
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Sprites: 4 tile sprite names (N, E, S, W facing)
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Sticky: Ignores stock rules: every item always on the shelf, unlimited
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Test: What this состояние measures. The fields below change to match
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Title: Optional. Shown instead of the key in these lists
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_TraitPick: Which trait to give or take away
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_UnlimitedStock: Leave blank for unlimited stock. Fill the second box to roll a random amount between the two
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_UnpSprites: 4 tile sprite names shown when machine is unpowered
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_VehiclePick: Choose one, or several for a random pick
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_ViewMode: Layout mode for the shop UI
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Weight: weight: relative to others in the same pool. Higher appears more often. Default 1.0
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_WeightOverride: (optional) weight: how often this appears. Higher is more common
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_WorldAge: In-game hours since the world started. Leave a box blank for no bound on that end
IGUI_PhunMart_Hint_Zones: With PhunZones, only sold in these difficulties (eg 1,2). Blank sells anywhere
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_NoEditorAccess: Недостаточно прав для редактора PhunMart. Доступ ограничен настройкой роли на сервере.
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_NoItemForShop: Для %1 нет переносного предмета автомата, поэтому установить его вручную нельзя.
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_PoolAdded: %1 добавлен в магазин. Пополните ассортимент, чтобы увидеть его.
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_PoolNotAdded: Объект %1 создан, но параметры магазина не удалось прочитать. Добавьте его через редактор.
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_Recompiling: Reloading definitions from the override files.
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_ShopDisabled: %1 is disabled. включить it before placing one
IGUI_PhunMart_Msg_SpawnedShopItem: %1 добавлен в инвентарь. Для установки нажмите ПКМ.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_BoundHint: Zero the bound totals as well, so nothing at all is carried forward.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_KillsHint: зомби kills banked toward kill token rewards.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_PlaytimeHint: Hours banked toward playtime token rewards.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_PurchasesHint: Per-player purchase counts. Clearing lets buy-once offers be bought again.
IGUI_PhunMart_Reset_WalletsHint: Clears spendable balances. Bound totals come back, the same as any wallet reset.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_CarAParts_tooltip: Поддерживайте транспорт в отличном состоянии с качественными запчастями.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_CSVPharmacy_tooltip: Не нужна страховка и лишние вопросы. Лекарства и многое другое.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_FinalAmendment_toolti: Оружие, патроны и всё, что поможет справиться с угрозами.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_GoodPhoods_tooltip: Свежие продукты, готовая еда и кухонная утварь.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_HardWear_tooltip: Качественная защитная одежда и снаряжение для стильного выживания.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_HoesNMoes_tooltip: Инструменты для ухода за садом и участком.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_MichellesCrafts_toolt: Сделайте апокалипсис ярче с творчеством и рукоделием.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_Phish4U_tooltip: Всё для активного отдыха: удочки, снасти, походное снаряжение и многое другое.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_PittyTheTool_tooltip: Прочные инструменты для восстановления мира после апокалипсиса.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_PrawnStars_tooltip: Есть золото? Выкупим украшения и другие ценности за наличные.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_RadioHacks_tooltip: Всё для электроники и самостоятельного ремонта.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_ShedsAndCommoners_too: Книги, журналы и другие развлечения во время апокалипсиса.
IGUI_PhunMart_Shop_WrentAWreck_tooltip: Автомобили, грузовики, прицепы и многое другое.
IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_HideTemplates: Templates are not sold by anything. Other entries copy them, so editing one changes every entry that copies it. Untick to see them, listed first. Typing a filter finds them anyway.
IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_OnlyChanged: Show only what you have customised. Blue stripe: you created it. Amber stripe: you edited one that ships with PhunMart.
IGUI_PhunMart_Tip_UsedBy: Click to go to what uses this.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Currency: Charge in an item such as money instead of the built-in change, and rescale every price to suit.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_NewShop: Set up a new machine step by step: how it looks, where it spawns, and what it stocks.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Pending: Machines already placed keep their old stock until they restock. Lists the ones your edits have affected.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_Recompile: Re-reads the override files from disk. Only needed after editing them by hand; saving in here already does it.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_ResetData: Clear wallets, purchase history and reward tracking for everyone at once. Pick what goes; nothing is ticked to start with.
IGUI_PhunMart_ToolDesc_RestockAll: Rerolls the stock of every machine in the world at once, changing what everyone can currently buy.
IGUI_PhunMart_Warn_GroupNoPrice: No price: these will not appear in a shop unless the pool sets one
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_FourTiles: Needs four names, one per facing. Found %1
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_NameChars: Needs at least one letter or number
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Err_NameTaken: That gives the key %1, which is already taken
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Appearance: Unused art gives it its own look. Copying another shop means the two are alike in the world
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Background: The image behind the shop window
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_BackgroundOther: Image filename from your own mod
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Category: Two shops sharing a category are kept apart in the world
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_MinDistance: Tiles from the nearest shop of this type or category. Blank follows the sandbox setting (%1)
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Name: Shown to players. The key is taken from this
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Price: Fallback price, used when an item has none of its own
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Probability: Chance of appearing relative to other shops, most of which use 15. Higher is more common, 0 is manual placement only
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Restock: Hours between restocks. Blank follows the sandbox setting (%1)
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Roll: Fewest and most it offers after a restock. It picks somewhere in this range each time
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Sprites: Four tile names from your tileset, comma separated: east, south, west, north
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Hint_Unpowered: Same four, for when the power is out. Blank if it needs no power
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Step_Look: What does the machine look like?
IGUI_PhunMart_Wiz_Step_Stock: How much does it stock, and at what price?
IGUI_PhunWallet.BalanceReplenishedOnDeat: Balance of %1 will be restored on смерть.
IGUI_UnfoldStockDesc: Разложить приклад для большей устойчивости при стрельбе.
UI_PhunWalletPanel: Your wallet balance across all currency pools
